summary: Phocus (Ancient Greek: Φῶκος) of Magnesia is an Argonaut, son of Caeneus and brother of Priasus. Hyginus lists the pair among Jason's comrades in Fabulae 14. He is not the Aeacid Phocus son of Aeacus, nor the eponymous heroes of Phocis.

sections.heading: Argonaut from Magnesia
paragraphs: Hyginus names Phocus and Priasus, sons of Caeneus from Magnesia, in the Argonaut catalogue. Beyond that roll-call the Magnesian Phocus has little independent myth — his identity is genealogical beside his brother Priasus.

sections.heading: Homonyms
paragraphs: This atlas entry (phocus-magnesian) is Caeneus' Argonaut alone. Distinct from the Aeacid Phocus (son of Aeacus and Psamathe), from Phocus son of Ornytion, and from other Phocus eponyms of Phocis listed on the same Wikipedia disambiguation page.
